metadata.title: feat(ui): display entity IDs in list tables and detail modals for all resource types
metadata.author: rakdutta

description:
Closes #3282 

## Summary

Platform administrators need quick access to entity IDs (Gateway, Server,
Tool, Agent) when configuring integrations or debugging without resorting
to the API. This change surfaces IDs directly in the Admin UI across all
resource types.

## Changes

### Templates
- `gateways_partial.html` — added "Gateway ID" column to list table
- `servers_partial.html` — added "Server ID" column to list table
- `tools_partial.html` — added "Tool ID" column to list table
- `agents_partial.html` — added "Agent ID" column to list table

All ID cells use `font-mono break-all max-w-32` for consistent display.

### JavaScript (admin.js)
- `makeCopyIdButton(id)` — new shared helper that creates a styled
  📋 Copy button using `navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(id))`;
  `String()` coercion safely handles both string and numeric IDs
- `viewGateway()` — added "Gateway ID" row with copy button via `makeCopyIdButton()`
- `viewServer()` — added "Server ID" row with copy button via   
  `makeCopyIdButton()`
- `viewTool()` — added "Tool ID" row with copy button via
  `makeCopyIdButton()`
- `viewAgent()` — added "Agent ID" row with copy button via
  `makeCopyIdButton()`
  - `viewPrompt()` — add  copy button via in "Prompt ID" row
  `makeCopyIdButton()`
- `viewResource()` — added "Resource ID" row with copy button via
  `makeCopyIdButton()`

The new ID columns are displayed correctly across Gateways, Servers, Tools, and Agents in the Admin UI, and the 📋 Copy button successfully copies the respective IDs to the clipboard.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
## Review: Approved

Rebased onto main (clean, no conflicts), reviewed, tested, and fixed.

### Original PR
- Adds entity ID columns to list tables (Gateways, Tools, Agents, Servers)
- Adds ID fields with copy-to-clipboard buttons in all 6 detail modals
- Shared `makeCopyIdButton()` helper with `String()` coercion for both string/numeric IDs
- Renames misleading "ID" → "S. No." (Agents), "UUID" → "Server ID" (Servers)

### Review Fixes Applied (2 commits)

**Commit 1** — `fix(ui): normalize viewServer ID styling and add makeCopyIdButton tests`
- Normalized `viewServer()` ID span classes to match all other view functions (`font-mono text-sm`)
- Added 8 unit tests for `makeCopyIdButton`

**Commit 2** — `fix(ui): address codex review — clipboard fallback, filter indexes, stale tests`
- **Clipboard fallback**: Added `execCommand("copy")` fallback when `navigator.clipboard` is unavailable, matching existing `copyToClipboard()` pattern
- **Filter column indexes**: Fixed `filterToolsTable` (columns `[2..10]` → `[3..11]`) and `filterA2AAgentsTable` (columns `[2..11]` → `[3..12]`) after ID column insertions shifted all subsequent columns
- **JS filter tests**: Updated tools and agents row data to include new ID columns
- **Playwright tests**: Updated expected headers and cell `.nth()` indexes in `test_agents_extended.py`, `test_gateways_extended.py`, and `test_tools_extended.py`
- **Copy button tests**: Added `execCommand` fallback and double-failure coverage (10 tests total)

### Testing
- All 815 JS unit tests pass (23 files)
- Playwright E2E: verified all 4 tabs show correct ID columns, modals display IDs with working Copy buttons, 0 new console errors
- No security issues (textContent throughout, no innerHTML, Jinja2 auto-escaping)
